summary: Started Bijan Robinson over Jonathan Taylor at running back.
alternatives: Taylor: Healthy, 14.0 projected and 15.7 season average. ESPN card cited 16.3 touches per game over his last four and said Seth McGowan is out, which could restore some work.
Robinson: Healthy, 17.7 projected and 19.8 season average. ESPN card cited 22.0 touches per game and recent receiving volume, with a difficult Vikings matchup.
Hall and Jeanty are viable backups, projected 13.8 and 15.3. Swift’s Thursday slot is locked. Irving stays in the Monday flex slot pending later review.

expected_benefit.basis: ESPN lineup display moved from 137.55 to 141.26. Robinson’s workload and receiving role favor him in reception scoring, with Taylor’s recent role and McGowan’s absence tempering confidence.

rationale: Both candidates were healthy on ESPN and start Sunday at 1 p.m. Eastern. Robinson’s greater reported workload and reception floor outweigh the difficult matchup. Taylor’s upside if vacated carries return is the strongest reason to keep him as first backup.
missing_evidence: Official Sunday inactives are not yet available.
execution_conditions: ESPN exposed an eligible swap between the two unlocked running backs.
fallback: If Robinson’s eligibility or health changes before Sunday at 1 p.m. Eastern, compare Taylor, Hall and Jeanty again.
verification: Reload displayed Robinson at RB, Taylor on the bench and Swift’s 29.2 actual points unchanged. See ../analysis/infographics/2026-week-12-robinson-for-taylor.png.
